statusDefinitions.implemented: Behavior exists and has an automated test for the stated scope.
statusDefinitions.partial: Behavior exists for a bounded subset; the limitation and evidence are listed.
statusDefinitions.planned: Not advertised. Follow-up work is recorded below.
statusDefinitions.unavailable: The active 0.1.1 toolchain explicitly does not provide this behavior.

advertisingRule: A capability is advertised only when advertised is true and evidence is non-empty. Partial capabilities must display their scope and limitation in Vitte: Show Capabilities.

editorFeatures.label: Syntax highlighting
editorFeatures.provider: TextMate grammar and LSP semantic tokens
editorFeatures.description: Highlights Vitte declarations, literals, operators, types, comments and strings.
editorFeatures.limitation: Lexical and lightweight syntactic scopes; this is not compiler-resolved type information.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: TextMate highlights current keywords and every canonical numeric form
test/language.test.cjs: semantic tokenization classifies types, bindings, fields and numbers

editorFeatures.label: Snippets
editorFeatures.description: Parser-compatible templates for common declarations and control flow.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: snippets use parser-compatible match, pick, import and external declarations

editorFeatures.label: Completion
editorFeatures.description: Keyword, builtin and indexed local-symbol completion.
editorFeatures.limitation: The list is not a compiler overload/type-resolution result; imported visibility and inferred types are limited.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: completion is suppressed inside comments and strings and offers keywords
test/language.test.cjs: bundled server serves completion over stdio LSP
src/test/suite/extension.test.ts: LSP E2E completion and navigation

editorFeatures.label: Signature help
editorFeatures.description: Shows signatures for declarations indexed in the open source context.
editorFeatures.limitation: Nested calls and UTF-16 positions are covered; compiler-resolved imported overloads are not.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: signature help counts arguments after strings containing surrogate pairs
src/test/suite/extension.test.ts: LSP E2E nested signature help

editorFeatures.label: Hover
editorFeatures.description: Provides short documentation for known keywords and primitive types.
editorFeatures.limitation: User symbols and compiler-derived type information do not have hover documentation.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: hover documents known keywords and primitive types

editorFeatures.label: Diagnostics
editorFeatures.provider: Language server plus the selected Vitte CLI
editorFeatures.description: Basic editor lint and structured compiler diagnostics from the detected CLI.
editorFeatures.limitation: Compiler results are only as reliable as the selected CLI version and the active frontend subset; simple LSP lint is not semantic analysis.
evidence: test/diagnostics.test.cjs: LSP diagnostic normalization preserves compiler spans and remediation
test/project.test.cjs: real compiler diagnostic envelopes identify Unicode source spans

editorFeatures.label: Document symbols
editorFeatures.description: Lists declarations found in the current document.
editorFeatures.limitation: Names are indexed from source structure and are not compiler symbol-table identities.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: bundled server serves document symbols over stdio LSP

editorFeatures.label: Workspace symbols
editorFeatures.description: The implementation currently searches open documents.
editorFeatures.limitation: It does not guarantee a complete or current result for unopened workspace files and has no end-to-end capability test.

editorFeatures.label: Go to definition
editorFeatures.description: Resolves tested declarations and references within indexed source documents.
editorFeatures.limitation: Resolution is source-index based, not a compiler symbol query; complex imports and shadowing are not guaranteed.
evidence: src/test/suite/extension.test.ts: LSP E2E definition resolves the tested declaration

editorFeatures.label: Find references
editorFeatures.description: Finds the tested declaration and use sites in indexed documents.
editorFeatures.limitation: Results are lexical/index based and are not a complete compiler reference graph.
evidence: src/test/suite/extension.test.ts: LSP E2E references return the declaration and call

editorFeatures.label: Rename symbol
editorFeatures.description: Renames tested declaration and use sites.
editorFeatures.limitation: The operation is not backed by compiler symbol identities; review cross-module edits before accepting them.
evidence: src/test/suite/extension.test.ts: LSP E2E rename updates declaration and call

editorFeatures.label: Code actions
editorFeatures.description: Offers diagnostic explanations, deterministic whitespace fixes and compiler-marked machine-applicable fixes.
editorFeatures.limitation: The LSP provider returns quick fixes only. Guessed import rewrites, aliases and role-contract templates were removed.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: bundled server applies a whitespace quick fix and returns no guessed edit for an unverified syntax error
src/test/suite/extension.test.ts: code actions explain diagnostics without invented syntax edits
src/test/suite/extension.test.ts: code actions apply only compiler-marked machine-applicable edits

editorFeatures.label: Formatting
editorFeatures.description: Applies deterministic whitespace and layout rules.
editorFeatures.limitation: It is a lightweight formatter, not a compiler AST formatter; syntax-specific transformations are excluded.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: formatter normalizes spacing and is idempotent

editorFeatures.label: Semantic tokens
editorFeatures.description: Highlights comments, strings, keywords, primitive types, declarations and basic identifiers.
editorFeatures.limitation: The token classification is lexical and declaration-context based; it is not compiler type information.
evidence: test/language.test.cjs: bundled server serves semantic tokens over stdio LSP

editorFeatures.label: Inlay hints
editorFeatures.description: A prototype infers a few literal types and parameter labels from line text.
editorFeatures.limitation: Hints are not compiler-resolved and can be wrong; disabled until compiler-backed hints have tests.

editorFeatures.label: Call hierarchy
editorFeatures.limitation: No compiler-resolved graph or automated capability test; disabled in LSP initialization.

editorFeatures.label: Type hierarchy
editorFeatures.limitation: No compiler-resolved graph or automated capability test; disabled in LSP initialization.

editorFeatures.label: Inline suggestions
editorFeatures.provider: Extension-local heuristic engine; optional AI pipeline
editorFeatures.description: Local n-gram, template and optional backend suggestions are experimental and are not language-server semantic results.
editorFeatures.limitation: Disabled by default. Prefer the language-server completion provider for language symbols.

editorFeatures.label: Native debugging
editorFeatures.provider: Bundled DAP adapter with LLDB and DWARF
editorFeatures.description: The bundled DAP backend is experimental. External DAP adapters can be configured independently.
editorFeatures.limitation: The repository DAP CI job targets Ubuntu 24.04. The active macOS arm64 run with compiler 0.1.1 fails DWARF frame, variable and breakpoint checks; Windows has no DAP gate.
evidence: src/test/suite/nativeDwarf.test.ts: frames, locals, aggregates and breakpoints
.github/workflows/ci.yml: Extension and native DAP on Ubuntu 24.04

compilerFrontends.label: C17 bootstrap frontend
compilerFrontends.description: Seed compiler and compatibility path; accepts a broader set of legacy sources than the native frontend in some areas, but is not the full language contract.

compilerFrontends.label: Native Vitte frontend (HIR/IR/C17)
compilerFrontends.description: Native lexer/parser/sema/HIR/IR/C17 path for the tested language subset; the CLI does not fall back to the bootstrap driver.

compilerFrontends.label: Self-host stages 0 to 3
compilerFrontends.description: The dated audit records earlier local macOS arm64 verification, but this checkout's make -j2 currently fails in the bootstrap parser before reproducing those stages.
evidence: make -j2 on 2026-11-27: bootstrap parser failed in src/compiler/backend/c17/ast_emitter.vitte and src/compiler/ir/ir.vitte

cliCommands.label: vitte compile / build
cliCommands.description: Compiles the documented native subset through C17 and the selected host C compiler.

cliCommands.label: vitte check
cliCommands.description: Checks syntax and semantics for the active frontend subset; other sources may use the documented compatibility path.

cliCommands.label: vitte run
cliCommands.description: Compiles and runs programs in the tested language subset using the host C17 toolchain.

cliCommands.label: vitte install
cliCommands.description: Installer verifies registry metadata and archive hashes; the public JSON package archive currently has a compatibility blocker.

cliCommands.label: vitte lex / parse / explain / version / help
cliCommands.description: CLI inspection and diagnostic commands implemented by the native driver.

cliCommands.label: vitte test
cliCommands.description: Recognized by the argument parser but rejected by the native driver in compiler 0.1.1.

cliCommands.label: vitte fmt
cliCommands.description: No formatter command is implemented in the native driver in compiler 0.1.1.

cliCommands.label: Cross-target compile
cliCommands.description: The native C17 host-tools path does not forward --target to a verified cross C toolchain.

followUps.label: Implement or remove placeholder enterprise report plugins
followUps.description: Do not map dead-code, documentation coverage or API-breakage reports to generic compiler checks. Add real tested providers or keep these plugin actions explicitly unavailable.

followUps.label: Verify the minimum VS Code engine and offline VSIX contents
followUps.description: Run the extension integration suite on VS Code 1.105, and retain release evidence that the packaged server, runtime dependencies, grammar, snippets and icon install and work from a local VSIX without a repository checkout.

followUps.label: Use compiler symbol/type APIs for semantic editor features
followUps.description: Replace text-index approximations for workspace symbols, cross-module navigation, inlay hints and hierarchies with compiler/LSP semantic data; add parity tests before advertising them.

followUps.label: Implement or remove v0.1.1 test and formatter CLI commands
followUps.description: The parser accepts these names but the native driver rejects them. Keep editor actions explicitly unavailable until command behavior and tests exist.

followUps.label: Close compiler platform and cross-target gates
followUps.description: Resolve and rerun Linux x86_64, macOS arm64 and Windows x86_64 release gates; publish no wider platform claim until toolchain jobs pass.

followUps.label: Move inline suggestions behind verified language-server results
followUps.description: Keep local n-gram/template and AI suggestion engines opt-in and experimental until outputs are validated against compiler/LSP semantics and stale candidates are rejected.

followUps.label: Pass native debugger gates on each supported toolchain
followUps.description: Resolve macOS 0.1.1 DAP/DWARF regressions and add Windows coverage before advertising the bundled native debugger on those platforms.
